text: to give myself unto wine: Heb. to draw my flesh with wine | all the days of their life: Heb. the number of the days of their life
servants born in my house: Heb. sons of my house
as musical instruments: , and that of all sorts: Heb. musical instrument, and instruments
even that which hath been already done: Or, in those things which have been already done
that wisdom excelleth folly: Heb. that there is an excellency in Wisdom more then in folly, etc
happeneth even to me: Heb. happeneth to me, even to me
should make his soul enjoy: Or, delight his senses
in his sight: Heb. before him
